propositions: _commit_binding_store_snapshot currently composes git_adapter.add + git_adapter.commit outside the atomic locked transaction, and commit_and_push_tickets_branch's git add -A staging sweeps in .bridge_state/last-pass.json, causing idempotent passes to advance HEAD incorrectly

_commit_binding_store_snapshot must route through a shared locked seam that accepts an optional pathspec parameter to scope staging to only the 5 intended .bridge_state files, excluding per-pass timestamp files

A new commit_tickets_branch seam must be extracted from commit_and_push_tickets_branch that commits under the shared write lock without pushing, accepting paths=None (git add -A) or paths=<sequence> (scoped staging)
Per-file idempotency must be preserved so that changes in any individual allowed file (e.g. bindings-retired.json) trigger a commit, while unchanged files do not advance HEAD
Failure contract must remain fail-open: seam failures raise PushDeliveryError, which existing broad exception handlers convert to False + stderr + dedup'd bridge_alerts
The raw-git-ok marker must be removable from reconcile_helpers.py after commit_tickets_branch is adopted, with scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py still passing
